title: Auto Loans tool reference: moving a loan's monthly due day
content:
# Auto Loans tool reference: moving a loan's monthly due day

This operations reference describes the Auto Loans tool change_due_day_df9bec35 at PCB.

## Situation of use and capability

The tool moves the monthly due day of one auto loan to the day the borrower chose, as a PCB service action. One call records the new day of the month on which installments fall due, records the next installment due date on that new day, and records today as the date of the latest due date change. The maturity date and the balances are not touched, and no fee is booked. The borrower sees the new due day and next due date on the loan afterwards.

## How it is invoked

An internal tool of the agent: it must first be unlocked with unlock_agent_discoverable_tool and then called with call_agent_discoverable_tool.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| auto_loan_id | the auto loan reference number of the loan whose due day moves, from the auto loan lookup for this borrower | reference number |
| new_due_day | the new day of the month for installments | whole number from 1 to 28 (a calendar day of the month) |
| next_payment_due_date | the next installment due date on the new due day | YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2031-03-28 |

## Return

On success the receipt shows status "due_day_changed" with: auto_loan_id (the loan reference number), payment_due_day (whole number 1 to 28), next_payment_due_date (YYYY-MM-DD) and last_due_date_change_date (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Input and receipt illustration (hypothetical values)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| auto_loan_id | the loan's reference number from the lookup |
| new_due_day | 18 |
| next_payment_due_date | 2026-10-18 |

A successful call returns status "due_day_changed", payment_due_day 18, next_payment_due_date 2026-10-18 and last_due_date_change_date set to the day of the call.

## Contract Q&A

**Does a call change the maturity date or charge a fee?** No. The maturity date and the balances are not touched and no fee is booked.

**Which date is recorded as the date of the change?** Today's date, the day of the call.
